purpose: Numbers as published by the original authors, recorded as BACKGROUND ONLY. These are NOT acceptance targets and check_acceptance.py does not read this file. See docs/roadmap.md for why: the papers use different features (and sometimes different splits), so a gap against them confounds implementation fidelity with feature choice. The acceptance reference is docs/mmsa_reference_mosi.json.
how_to_read: Our runs use MMSA's preprocessed features: text BERT-768, audio 5-dim, vision 20-dim. Where a paper used something else, the 'features' field says so, and a direct number comparison is invalid in both directions — being ahead is no more meaningful than being behind.

mult.paper: Tsai et al., Multimodal Transformer for Unaligned Multimodal Language Sequences, ACL 2019

features.audio: COVAREP (12 MFCC, pitch tracking, voiced/unvoiced, glottal source)

mult.note: All three modalities differ from ours. Aligned uses P2FA word-level alignment with averaging inside each word span.
mult.divergences_from_mmsa: MMSA uses batch 16, lr 2e-3, hidden 50, conv kernel 5/5/5, text dropout 0.5, attn dropout 0.3, output dropout 0.5, clip 0.6, and no positional encoding. Only the block count (4) and head count (10) agree.

pending.note: Not yet extracted. Each needs its own paper checked the same way — from the published tables, not from memory or from a secondary source.
pending.unavailable: ef_lstm and lf_dnn have no originating paper; they are MMSA's own baselines.
